--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Bytes Format Units   Label     Explanations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   1- 10 A10    ---     PSR       PSR name (J2000)
  12- 17 F6.4   s       Per       Period of the pulsar
  19- 24 F6.2   pc.cm-3 DM        Dispersion measure
  26- 30 I5     ---     Npulse    Number of pulses detected in the single-pulse searching pipeline
  32- 37 I6     ---     Ntot      Total number of periods in the observation
  39- 43 F5.2   ---     MaxSPSN   S/N of the brightest single pulse detected
  45- 49 F5.2   ---     MinSPSN   S/N of the faintest single pulse detected
  51- 55 F5.1   ---     FluRatio  Fluence ratio (1)
  57- 57 A1     ---     Class     [LGUO-] Energy distribution classifications
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Note (1): Energy distribution classifications if more than 100 single pulses 
    are detected as follows:
    L = Lognormal;
    G = Gaussian;
    U = Unimodal;
    O = Other;
    - = <100 single pulses.
